title: Linear-Core Surrogates: Smooth Loss Functions with Linear Rates for Classification and Structured Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2604.27742v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A fundamental dichotomy in the theory of classification sets smoothness against statistical efficiency: smooth surrogate losses such as the logistic loss enable fast $O(1/T)$ optimization but yield slow square-root $H$-consistency bounds, while piecewise-linear losses like the Hinge loss achieve optimal linear $H$-consistency rates but are non-differentiable. We introduce Linear-Core (LC) Surrogates, the first family of explicit convex loss functions that provably resolve this tension. By stitching a linear core to a smooth tail, we construct surrogates that are differentiable everywhere ($C^1$, and even $C^2$ under mild conditions) while retaining strict linear $H$-consistency bounds, the strongest known form of consistency guarantee. We establish these linear bounds across three increasingly complex settings: binary classification, multi-class classification, and structured prediction. translated_title: 线性核心替代损失函数：具有线性速率的平滑损失函数用于分类与结构化预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.27742v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：分类理论中的一个基本二分法将平滑性与统计效率对立起来：平滑替代损失函数（如逻辑损失）能够实现快速的$O(1/T)$优化，但产生缓慢的平方根$H$-一致性界，而分段线性损失函数（如铰链损失）能达到最优的线性$H$-一致性速率，但不可微。我们引入了线性核心（LC）替代损失函数，这是首个能够明确解决这一矛盾的凸损失函数族。通过将线性核心与平滑尾部拼接，我们构建了处处可微（$C^1$，且在温和条件下甚至$C^2$）的替代损失函数，同时保持严格的线性$H$-一致性界，这是已知最强形式的一致性保证。我们在三种日益复杂的场景中建立了这些线性界：二元分类、多类分类和结构化预测。据我们所知，这是首个明确的凸损失函数族，能够同时实现可微性和线性一致性速率。
tldr: 本文提出了线性核心替代损失函数，通过将线性核心与平滑尾部拼接，首次实现了处处可微且具有严格线性$H$-一致性界的凸损失函数，解决了分类理论中平滑性与统计效率之间的根本矛盾。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Linear-Core surrogates, the first explicit convex loss family that achieves both differentiability and strict linear H-consistency bounds by stitching a linear core to a smooth tail, resolving the fundamental tension between smoothness and statistical efficiency in classification.
